title: Autonomous Internal QA & Playtest Agents
objective: Create internal developer/creator agents that can execute deterministic scenarios and bounded visual/interaction tasks, compare expected state/screens, collect logs/video/performance evidence, minimize/reproduce failures and emit bug bundles. This is not external tester recruitment and creates no SMB-13/BRP distribution authority.

scope.purpose: Provide bounded internal QA/playtest-agent tooling over deterministic scenario and analysis contracts without granting canonical game-state mutation, external testing/distribution or automatic patch authority.
included: log, video and performance evidence collection
scope.completion_gate: Representative internal scenarios can be selected/replayed under governed owner projections, compared against expected state/screens, and reduced to reproducible evidence/bug bundles while canonical mutation and external tester/distribution authority remain outside PCA-14.

selection_boundaries: PCA-11 retained governed character-intelligence, capability and bounded action authority; PCA-14 consumed explicit character-plan references only and created no unrestricted NPC/GM mutation authority.
PCA-12 retained deterministic/stochastic simulation and analysis-evidence authority; PCA-14 consumed analysis references without promoting findings into canonical game state or balance truth.
Owner domains retained canonical gameplay/content/state authority; PCA-14 compared supplied projections and performed no owner-state mutation or hidden canonical ledger creation.
SMB-13 and BRP retained external tester recruitment, distribution and product-readiness authority; PCA-14 remained internal developer/creator QA only.

State/screen/interaction checks, logs, video, performance evidence, failure minimization and bug bundles remained deterministic and advisory; no automatic patch, network/provider execution, paid-service activation, public upload, publication or release occurred.

ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH.json schema 1.0.3 was reconsulted after exact-tree PCA-14 publication. MCS, MCCS and MSAS remain blocked until PCA-15 satisfies FOUR_LANE_RELEASE_BARRIER; PCA-15's own PCA-01 gate is satisfied, so PCA-15 is the lawful next selected item.

PCA-15 is selected_not_started only; no implementation branch or authority exists until a later owner Continue governed-starts it. PCA-16, MCS, MCCS, MRCS, MSAS, SMB-08 and downstream work remain unauthorized.
